messages:
Aly (sre): noticed a spike of 503s hitting hosted inference at ~09:12 UTC, correlated with a model hot-swap in pool-prod-us-west-2
MonitorBot: alerts: upstream-runner-evict high error-rate -> 1200 5xxs in 3m for model:redwood/llama-13b-v2-hot
Maya (oncall): I can see repeated worker exits on host gpu-72-az3, containers restarted by kube every ~12s
Priya (eng-runner): logs show a SIGSEGV followed by CUDA OOM on the same PID during prefetch stage. grabbing recent core/logs now
Priya (eng-runner): paste: ```
2026-02-21T09:12:34Z runner[pid:8421] ERROR: kv_prefetch:alloc failed: CUDA out of memory
2026-02-21T09:12:34Z runner[pid:8421] FATAL: unexpected signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7fffa2c3
GPU 0: Xid 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
stack: 0x7f8a9c... at serve_attention.cu:412
```
Jamal (support): customer AcmeCorp reported timeouts and 503s from 09:12->09:21, they saw retries and some doubled billing attempts; CS on call is Sen
Sen (cs): Acme on a call now, they provided sample request ids: req_0a1b2c3d, req_0a1b2c3e. They saw p95 latency spike then 503s
Aly (sre): routing fallback should've sent to fallback-dedicated tier. it looks like fallback rules failed on auth check for some tokens (403 path) so retries hit same pool and amplified failure
Priya (eng-runner): reproducer: perform hot-swap load with concurrent KV-prefetch heavy context (approx 200k token prefetched) -> memory balloon -> kernel segfault. repro on dev cluster with similar model and quant profile
Maya (oncall): mitigation applied: disabled hotmodel-handoff for the pool, initiated model rollback to v2-stable (no prefetch), cordoned gpu-72-az3 host, drained remaining tasks
DeployBot: rollback job started: deploy/rollback-redwood/llama-13b-v2-stable -> 09:18:06 UTC
Aly (sre): temporary firewall rule added to stop traffic from gateway->pool-prod-us-west-2 for non-enterprise tokens (reduces blast radius)
Jamal (support): told Acme to pause heavy batch jobs and posted expected ETA 09:30 UTC for rollback completion. asked for any request ids to blacklist if replays appear
Priya (eng-runner): stack trace and a minimal patch candidate: guard KV prefetch when mem_available < threshold, or fall back to streaming prefetch. patch PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/runner/+/1593
Priya (eng-runner): quick patch landed to gate prefetch, will push to canary after rollback is stable
Maya (oncall): after rollback latency and 5xx count falling. p95 back to normal by 09:28 UTC. still monitoring for single-digit restarts
Sen (cs): Acme confirms service returning to normal, still asking about billing credit for retries — flagged to billing ops
Aly (sre): root cause hypothesis: hotmodel handoff triggered extra KV prefetch work concurrently with large-context sessions leading to GPU memory fragmentation + OOM -> kernel SIGSEGV -> container restart loop -> 503s. Amplified because routing fallback was blocked by an auth gating bug introduced in auth-proxy v1.7.2
Priya (eng-runner): repro steps we recorded: 
1) start long-context session (~150k tokens) against model v2-hot
2) trigger hot-swap by deploying new variant 
3) send 50 parallel batched toolcalls (embed-heavy)
4) observe OOM + SIGSEGV within ~30s
We pushed an integration test to exercise hot-swap under heavy prefetch load
Jamal (support): open incident ticket INC-2026-0234 for customer billing; CS to coordinate credits
Aly (sre): follow-ups: (1) revert auth-proxy change that blocks fallback (2) safely disable prefetch during hotmodel-handovers (3) schedule canary of prefetch-guard patch (4) add alarm for rapid container-restart-per-host > 5/min
Maya (oncall): I'll take (4) and (1) today. Priya please lead (2)/(3) with eng-ml. Jamal/Sen handle customer comms and billing follow-up
Priya (eng-runner): ack. creating PRs and canary plan in #eng-runtime. PR link posted above.
Sen (cs): noted, Acme wants a postmortem and cc list for follow-ups. I'll draft a customer-facing summary once we have root cause confirmed
Aly (sre): thanks all — incident declared resolved at 09:31 UTC pending postmortem. saving logs + heapdumps at s3://redwood-incident/7213456789/
MonitorBot: metrics quieted: 5xx rate down 95%, active restarts per host -> 0
Maya (oncall): closing channel for now, will reopen if any regression seen.
